dominant_in_sector_1.gml: var c = 0; for (var n = 0; n < 1000; n++) { if (map_pick_faction(1) == "bandits") c += 1; } return (c > 500 && c < 700);

present_in_sector_2.gml: for (var n = 0; n < 800; n++) { if (map_pick_faction(2) == "bandits") return true; } return false;

never_in_sector_3.gml: for (var n = 0; n < 800; n++) { if (map_pick_faction(3) == "bandits") return false; } return true;

sector_3_maps_clean.gml: for (var m = 0; m < 40; m++) { global.run.sector = 3; map_generate(); var nd = global.run.map.nodes; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(nd); i++) { if (nd[i].faction == "bandits") return false; } } return true;

calm.gml: global.cb.player.hull = 900; var pc = global.cb.player; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(pc.facs); i++) { if (fac(pc.facs[i].def).charge > 0) pc.facs[i].hp = 0; } for (var e = 0; e < array_length(global.cb.enemies); e++) { var t = global.cb.enemies[e]; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(t.facs); i++) { if (fac(t.facs[i].def).charge > 0) t.facs[i].hp = 0; } } return true;

flagged.gml: for (var e = 0; e < array_length(global.cb.enemies); e++) { if (!global.cb.enemies[e].no_repair) return false; } return true;

fit_shield.gml: var c = global.run.car; while (array_length(c.facs) > 0) car_remove(c, 0); var want = ["reac_2", "shd_1"]; for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) { var s = car_find_space(c, fac(want[i]).cells); if (is_array(s)) car_place(c, want[i], s[0], s[1], 0); } return array_length(c.facs);
